edits.new:
The dependency-added column records the build dependency of the owning story. This story has no build dependency: an ITG story waits on no build of its own, and its I dependencies are the APP stories listed in the metadata table.

Schema ownership: this story owns no schema. The schema rwb_document named in the DP-01 row is owned by RWB-P5-E1050-APP; the suite changes no schema.

Classifier: the classify step is built as a service-internal capability behind ClassifierClient, with a stub and the route property rwb.dochub.classify.model-route; no new dependency id is added. The rwb-agent and model-gateway satellite is tracked as external work. The provider, endpoint and model version string are confirmed before the SIT evaluation.

Classification answer: the published contract does not yet carry classifierVersion, reviewReason or the two candidate types with their confidence; the story reads them from the extended rwb-document contract and its fake until the contract story is raised.

Artefact and deployment: the classifier artefact is pinned by digest and promoted and rolled back as one (chart, artefact) pair with no schema change; promotion is gated on 162 of 180 in the evaluation report. The alert shares, windows, replica counts, KEDA thresholds, probe timings and report container are values entries set at the SIT entry check.
